title: Count Vowel Substrings of a String
goal: Count substrings made only of vowels and containing all five vowel types.
strategy: Track the last occurrence of each vowel and the most recent consonant. At each endpoint, valid starts lie after that consonant and no later than the earliest of the five last occurrences.
